English.Char_Desc_450: Check AI prompts for sensitive data and review repository secrets on Windows. By Aurelio Avila. Review limitations and access requirements on the official product page. Windows downloads are publisher-signed and timestamped; signing is not a safety guarantee. Screenshots illustrate the app and may show an earlier release.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Redaxa by Aurelio Avila checks AI prompts for personal data and recognizable secret patterns, with redaction before sharing. Prompt text is processed by Redaxa's servers and is not sent to an AI provider; this is not an offline-only prompt scanner. Paid Windows repository-review tools run locally. Detection is a review aid, not a guarantee that every secret is found or that a repository is secure. Web, Chrome and Windows interfaces have different access requirements; consult the official plan page and checkout for current paid plans and eligible trials. Official Windows binaries are publisher-signed and timestamped. Screenshots illustrate the interface and are not security test results.
